title: Counterfactual Stacking in the Past Conditional: Ha... volna, akkor... lett volna

sections.title: Forming Past Counterfactual Hypotheses
sections.content: You know the past counterfactual from B1 Unit 39, and B2 Unit 69 stacked several such clauses. Counterfactual conditionals describe events in the past that did not happen, with their unreal consequences. The particle *volna* stands after a past-tense verb in both clauses: 'Ha a kutatók korábban kezdték volna el a projektet, a modell már tavaly elkészült volna.'

sections.title: Stacking Clauses and Deductive Sequences
sections.content: In complex scientific discourse, counterfactual conditions often stack across multiple subclauses, demonstrating chains of cause and effect: 'Ha nem fejlesztették volna ki a morfológiai elemzőt, a rendszer nem lett volna képes kezelni a magyar ragokat, és a modell félreértette volna a fókuszos szerkezeteket.'

sections.title: Past Counterfactual Formations in Hungarian
rows: Ha több adat állt volna rendelkezésre, a modell pontosabb lett volna.
If more data had been available, the model would have been more accurate.
Ha nem építettek volna digitális korpuszt, a nyelv lemaradt volna.
If they had not built a digital corpus, the language would have lagged behind.
Megoldották volna a feladatot, ha ismerték volna az algoritmust.
They would have solved the problem if they had known the algorithm.

items.spanish: Ha a nyelvészek nem digitalizálták volna a szövegeket, ma nem lennének magyar nyelvi modellek.
items.english: If linguists had not digitized the texts, there would not be Hungarian language models today.

items.spanish: A rendszer sokkal lassabban tanult volna, ha nem használtak volna grafikus processzorokat.
items.english: The system would have learned much more slowly if they had not used graphics processing units.

items.spanish: Ha elkerülték volna a morfológiai hibákat, a fordítóprogram tökéletes eredményt adott volna.
items.english: If they had avoided morphological errors, the translation program would have produced a perfect result.

sections.title: B2 Usage Notice
sections.content: Remember: 'volna' never attaches as a suffix; it is an invariant particle. In negative past conditional clauses, 'nem' precedes the verb and 'volna' follows: 'nem vett volna észre' (would not have noticed).
